header: How long it lasts, who runs it, what gets shown
lead: The pitch for a live demonstration, with the agenda as icon points between a rule above and a rule below.
note: The band links to a scheduling page and never embeds a calendar: a third-party booking script would load into every page carrying this element.

agenda.title: Up to six points
agenda.text: Each an icon, a title and one sentence. Leave the collection empty and the rules disappear with it.

agenda.title: Two to four columns
agenda.text: The agenda reflows on the room it has rather than on the width of the viewport.

agenda.title: Media on either side
agenda.text: Reverse swaps the halves; without an image the copy takes the whole band.

agenda.title: One button, one link
agenda.text: The primary action opens the calendar and the quieter one is for a reader not ready to pick a time.
